name: response_usefulness
definition: Whether the agent final response provides a genuinely useful, substantive answer to the user question. A response that apologizes, says it cannot help, returns no data, provides only generic filler, or loops without resolving the question is NOT useful.

categories.name: meaningful
categories.definition: The response directly and substantively addresses the user question with specific, actionable information.

categories.name: unhelpful
categories.definition: The response does NOT meaningfully answer the user question. This includes: (1) The agent said 'I don't have that information', gave generic advice, or directed the user elsewhere instead of using its tools. (2) The agent apologized without answering. (3) Empty data results or generic filler text. (4) The agent looped without resolution.

categories.name: partial
categories.definition: The response partially addresses the question but is incomplete, missing key details, or only tangentially relevant.

name: task_grounding
definition: Whether the agent response is grounded in actual data retrieved from its tools, or is fabricated / hallucinated general knowledge.

categories.name: grounded
categories.definition: The response is clearly based on data retrieved from the agent tools (search results, database lookups, API calls).

categories.name: ungrounded
categories.definition: The response appears to be fabricated or based on the LLM general knowledge rather than actual tool results. The tool may have returned empty data and the agent filled in anyway.

categories.name: no_tool_needed
categories.definition: The question did not require tool usage and a direct LLM response was appropriate.

name: correctness
definition: Whether the facts stated in the agent response are accurate. Evaluate based on the information the agent retrieved from its tools and whether it was conveyed faithfully.

categories.name: correct
categories.definition: All facts stated by the agent are accurate and consistent with the tool results retrieved.

categories.name: mostly_correct
categories.definition: The response is mostly correct but contains a minor inaccuracy, omission, or imprecise wording.

categories.name: incorrect
categories.definition: The response contains wrong facts, hallucinated information, or claims contradicted by the tool results.

name: tool_usage
definition: Whether the agent used its available tools correctly to answer the question, rather than relying on general knowledge.

categories.name: proper
categories.definition: The agent used its tools and based the answer on the tool results. Tools were called with appropriate parameters.

categories.name: partial
categories.definition: The agent partially used tools, or tool usage was unclear or incomplete. Some information may not be tool-derived.

categories.name: none
categories.definition: The agent answered from general knowledge without looking up information via tools, even though tools were available and the question warranted their use.

name: specificity
definition: Whether the agent response provides specific, concrete details (numbers, dates, dollar amounts, limits) rather than vague or generic statements.

categories.name: specific
categories.definition: The response includes specific and complete details: exact numbers, percentages, dollar amounts, dates, or limits.

categories.name: somewhat_specific
categories.definition: The response is somewhat specific but missing some key details that would make it fully actionable.

categories.name: vague
categories.definition: The response is vague, generic, or missing key specifics that the user needs to act on the information.

name: scope_compliance
definition: Whether the agent correctly handled the scope of the question. An agent should answer in-scope questions and politely decline out-of-scope ones.

categories.name: compliant
categories.definition: The agent correctly answered an in-scope question OR correctly declined an out-of-scope question.

categories.name: partially_compliant
categories.definition: The agent answered but with unnecessary caveats, excessive hedging, or was partially out of scope.

categories.name: non_compliant
categories.definition: The agent tried to answer an out-of-scope question it should have declined, OR refused to answer an in-scope question it should have handled.

name: first_time_right
definition: Whether the agent's FIRST response in the conversation was satisfactory, without needing user corrections or follow-ups to fix errors. For single-turn conversations, evaluate the only response. For multi-turn, focus on whether the first substantive answer was correct.

categories.name: correct
categories.definition: The first response was correct and complete. No correction or significant clarification was needed from the user.

categories.name: clarification_needed
categories.definition: The first response was mostly right but needed minor clarification or a follow-up to be fully useful.

categories.name: correction_needed
categories.definition: The first response was wrong, vague, or incomplete enough that the user had to push back or correct the agent.
